text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a coordinated rollout next week across US/EU/APAC. Need a quick alignment on bump timing, merge-gate, and changelog cut. Proposing:

alex: US canary start: Mon 08:00 PT
alex: EU full rollout: Mon 16:00 PT / Tue 00:00 CET
alex: APAC gradual: Tue 02:00 PT (evening JST/AEST)

maria: That APAC slot collides with oncall handover for some infra folks. Can we shift APAC 2h later to avoid noisy midnight ops? :thinking:

cheng: 2h shift is fine for infra, but ops wants 30m warmup + 1h shadow canary before full traffic. So total APAC window becomes ~1.5–2h.

sam: Quick checklist from release side:
- branch freeze: 6h before US canary
- changelog cut: 4h before canary (we need final PR list)
- migration plan: any DB changes must be gated with rollout flag

liz: On changelog: I can assemble the PR list if I get a final branch list by EOD today. Ping me with components.

alex: Noted. I'll post branch list in ~30m. For merge-gate: do we want a hard gate (manual sign-off) or automated check (smoke + error rate)?

maria: We should do automated smoke + manual for infra-critical changes. SRE approves auto-smoke; infra/team lead does manual for infra-touching PRs.

cheng: Deploy-run snippet (for ops reference):
```
# kickoff
deployctl start --env prod --region us --canary 5%
wait 30m
deployctl promote --region eu --canary 20%
# APAC gradual later with shadow
```

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window template posted in #eng-oncall. Use tags: `release-1940012345` and `merge-gate-approved`.

sam: One more: metric watchlist for canary -> latency p50/p95, error-rate, token-cost-per-req, cpu/gpu-util. Anyone add to the grafana snapshot?

liz: I'll add token-cost and p95. Cheng can you add model-kvcache hit rate? That helps for performance regressions.

cheng: Yup will add kvcache metric and a short dashboard link in the runbook.

alex: OK. Action items:
- alex: post branch list (30m)
- liz: assemble changelog once branches posted
- cheng: add kvcache metric + runbook snippet
- maria: confirm oncall coverage shift with ops (2h later)
- sam: prepare autoscale guardrails for canary

alex: If no objections I'll lock the schedule and merge-gate policy in 6h. Thanks :thumbsup:
